status: predeclared checksum-only amendment before any Phase 3 outcome fitting
purpose: Test whether fixed partial endpoint-order abstractions add held-out next-bar close-to-close directional predictive code-length beyond learned lag-one close direction; retrospective diagnostic, never prospective confirmation
previous_exposure: ALL BTCUSDT snapshots, the 30-minute prior signal, and the 2023–2026 outcomes were inspected in prior Filang direction and R1–R3 campaigns. This new modeling method cannot make the test dates fresh. The 30-minute primary timeframe was chosen because of those prior outcomes.
dependency_base: Phase 2 commit 536fa53969ed1510057a72dd6ecd77c575b211ef on PR #30; Phase 1 PR #29

target.flat_policy: Exclude exactly zero target returns from binary fit and score, retain and report them
target.feature_availability: at close of candle t; future target available at close of candle t+1
target.gap_policy: require t-1,t,t+1 to have contiguous UTC opening timestamps on the declared fixed grid; retain actual rows and never fill gaps
target.fold_boundary: source candle t opens within fold, target candle t+1 must close strictly before the end-exclusive boundary; fitting can use only observations with target close strictly before outer fold start
target.validation: strict positive finite OHLC, high>=max(open,close)>=min(open,close)>=low, nonnegative finite volume; unique increasing aligned timestamps; exact IEEE floating equality for ties

period.training: For each outer fold, fit baseline and alternatives separately on all eligible observations starting 2020-01-01 whose target close is strictly before fold start. No hyperparameter selection or model refit within the outer fold.

estimator.baseline: P(Y=up | lag_state)=(up_lag+0.5)/(n_lag+1), fallback to global (up+0.5)/(n+1) if lag stratum empty
estimator.alternatives: P(Y=up | lag_state,signature)=(up_cell + alpha*P(Y=up|lag_state))/(n_cell+alpha), with zero n_cell falling back to corresponding baseline
estimator.numerical: float64 probabilities and natural-log binary log loss, no clipping needed because smoothed 0<p<1; report all eligible score rows and fit counts

primary.measure: mean(log_loss_baseline - log_loss_joint) in nats per binary event, plus total saved bits=sum(log_loss_baseline-log_loss_joint)/ln(2)
criteria: primary 7-day paired moving-block bootstrap 95% percentile interval lower endpoint > 0
at least 3 of 4 annual point estimates positive
primary.conclusion: All conditions passing => supported only as a *retrospective within-protocol criterion*, not fresh confirmation; completed failure => not-supported; missing data, incomplete run or failed audit => inconclusive.
primary.caveat: Primary was chosen due to prior data-selected 30m interest, so nominal p and interval do not account for that adaptive history.

secondary.selection: No secondary, time-frame or schema may replace primary or open a new success route; every secondary number is descriptive.

uncertainty.unit: UTC day of target candle close
uncertainty.sampling: For each annual fold independently, sample circular contiguous blocks of days until its exact original number of calendar days is obtained; retain days with zero scored targets; resample paired daily difference sum and event count using the same indices
uncertainty.intervals: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of weighted pooled mean difference
uncertainty.p: For centered null, subtract pooled observed per-event gain * daily target count from each day's difference sum; resample these centered sums using the same block indices. One-sided p=(hits of resampled centered gain >= observed gain + 1)/(replicates + 1)

placebo.scope: 30m primary only, descriptive, not a p-value or evidence of a causal market null
placebo.operation: Within each outer fold's fitting events and separately its scored events, circularly rotate the ordered joint schema signature codes forward by s = nominal_days * 1440 / timeframe_minutes positions, wrapping within the phase. Leave Y and lag_state, baseline predictions, fold membership and counts unchanged. Refit shifted conditional cells; score shifted held-out signatures.
placebo.interpretation: Breaks contemporaneous alignment while preserving marginal signature sequence and local autocorrelation, but is an intentionally noncausal placebo and does not preserve all joint OHLC dynamics.

prospective_gate.requirement: Separately freeze an actual future source and its immutable provenance before labels are inspected. Nothing in this retrospective run is called prospective confirmation.
prospective_gate.acceptance: No claimed future confirmation in R0; future datasets or asset choices require a separately predeclared protocol and Law 1 outcome record.

source_policy.use: Use exact pre-prepared CSVs from prior immutable Vaquum Binance BTCUSDT sources; verify full SHA-256, row count, grid, and original provenance; do not commit raw market data.

artifacts.native: One native Phase 2 signature key row per input bar (including feature-valid final rows with unknown future Y), source-index aligned; no future labels read by native encoder; source hashes checked
artifacts.producer: Complete per-year predictions (baseline and 3 fixed alternatives), fit summaries and annual/daily log-loss summaries; full source-index alignment
artifacts.verifier: Independent Python reconstruction of canonical endpoint weak-order relations and body directions, exact keys, lag/target eligibility, fit counts, and every scored prediction and log loss; report maximum discrepancy and reject missing or altered rows
artifacts.report: Frozen protocol identity, implementation commit and source checksums, exact metric values, uncertainty/placebo conditions, annual outcomes, complete results and any failures
artifacts.full_arrays: Keep full row-level artifacts in ignored local run directory; commit compact audited JSON reports and verification receipt.
artifacts.performance: No claim of a runtime speedup or throughput factor; all computation must be auditable, and execution times if recorded are operational receipts only.

amendment_scope: Correct only the 120m prepared CSV SHA-256 transcription (r0 had 9ae8 after 7d7 instead of actual 8b64 after 7d); no hypothesis, source bytes, dates, models, criteria or statistical procedure changed.
